# Chop

> Chop is a Nigerian group payment app for splitting bills, pooling funds, and collecting for group orders — entirely via a shareable web link. No app download required for participants.

## What Chop does

Chop lets one person (the organiser) create a payment session and share a single link on WhatsApp or any group chat. Everyone in the group opens the link in their browser and pays their share instantly — no sign-up, no app install needed on their end.

## Session modes

- **Chop Food**: Group meal orders where each participant selects exactly what they ate and pays their individual dish breakdown. Best for office lunches, suya nights, birthday dinners.
- **Chop In**: Group fund pooling toward a shared goal or contribution. Each person chips in whatever amount they choose. Best for birthday gifts, trips, owambe contributions, and party funds.
- **Chop Bill**: Automated expense splitting for shared costs. Split equally or by custom percentage. Best for rent, electricity bills, and shared ride costs.

## Key facts

- Built for Nigeria; payments processed in Naira (NGN)
- Participants need only a web browser — no account, no download
- Payment links generate rich WhatsApp preview cards automatically
- Real-time payment status: organisers see who has paid (green) and who still owes (red) instantly
- Creating a session is free; a small processing fee applies per payment
- Web app only — available at https://usechop.xyz

## Who it is for

Groups of friends, colleagues, or family members who need to collect or split money without the friction of bank transfers, follow-ups, or awkward reminders. Especially useful for Nigerian group chats on WhatsApp.
